name: Flat Trend EA
summary: Flat Trend EA is a mean reversion expert advisor that identifies flat/ranging market conditions using a flat trend indicator and enters trades when price deviates from its range equilibrium. It aims to capitalize on price returning to the mean during sideways markets by detecting overbought and oversold conditions within a defined channel.
summary_zh: Flat Trend EA是一个均值回归型智能交易系统，通过平坦趋势指标识别横盘/震荡市场条件，在价格偏离区间均衡点时入场交易。它旨在利用价格在侧向市场中回归均值的特性，通过检测定义通道内的超买和超卖条件来获利。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于识别市场横盘（Flat）状态，在价格触及通道上下边界时进行均值回归交易。入场条件为：当Flat Trend指标显示市场处于横盘状态且价格触及通道上轨时做空，触及下轨时做多。出场条件包括：价格回归通道中线时平仓、达到止盈目标或止损触发。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未发现动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺少风险比例计算，未根据账户余额动态调整仓位大小。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但缺少对趋势市场与震荡市场的切换判断，可能在趋势行情中产生连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on identifying flat/ranging market states and executing mean reversion trades when price touches the upper or lower boundaries of a channel. Entry conditions: go short when the Flat Trend indicator shows a sideways market and price touches the upper channel band; go long when price touches the lower channel band. Exit conditions include: closing positions when price returns to the channel midline, reaching take-profit targets, or stop-loss being triggered. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach with no dynamic lot adjustment mechanism detected. Money management lacks risk-proportional calculation and does not dynamically adjust position size based on account balance. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward but lacks a mechanism to distinguish between trending and ranging markets, which could lead to consecutive losses during trending periods.
pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和调优
在横盘市场中表现良好，能有效捕捉均值回归机会
参数较少，降低了过拟合的风险
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and tune
Performs well in ranging markets, effectively captures mean reversion opportunities
Few parameters reduce the risk of overfitting
cons: 缺少趋势过滤器，在趋势行情中可能持续亏损
固定手数仓位管理不够灵活，未考虑账户风险比例
横盘检测指标可能产生滞后信号，导致入场时机不佳
缺少新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks a trend filter, may suffer consecutive losses in trending markets
Fixed lot position sizing is inflexible, does not consider account risk ratio
Flat detection indicator may produce lagging signals, leading to poor entry timing
Lacks new bar check mechanism, may open multiple positions on the same bar
improvements: 添加趋势过滤器（如ADX或均线斜率），在趋势行情中暂停交易
实现基于账户风险比例的动态仓位管理
添加新K线检查和时间过滤功能，避免重复开仓和非活跃时段交易
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or moving average slope) to pause trading during trending markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk ratio
Add new bar check and time filter functionality to avoid duplicate entries and trading during inactive sessions

risk_points: 缺少趋势过滤器可能在趋势行情中持续逆势交易
固定手数未考虑账户风险承受能力
可能缺少新K线检查导致同根K线重复开仓
risk_points_en: Lack of trend filter may cause sustained counter-trend trading in trending markets
Fixed lot size does not account for account risk tolerance
May lack new bar check leading to duplicate position openings on the same bar

It aims to capitalize on price returning to the mean during sideways markets by detecting overbought and oversold conditions within a defined channel.
